subject: Air freight quote to ORD
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to ORD (Chicago, US)? Please arrange the truck from our site in 85791 (Ingolstadt), Germany, to the departure airport. The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28.

We are shipping 2 pieces of spare parts for packaging machines, with a gross weight of 1445 kg and a volume of 4.07 cbm.

Please give us an all-in price in EUR, including pickup.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH
